claim: synchronizeStripeWithJetstreamUserIfRequired hands off to the team sync path using the user's id as teamId instead of the newly created team's id, so the team-scoped entitlement sync operates on the wrong identifier and the just-created team is never correctly synchronized.

createTeamForTeamPlanCustomer calls updateCustomerMetadata without awaiting or handling its result, so a failed write of the authorization-relevant type/teamId metadata is silently dropped instead of surfaced, where the prior code explicitly awaited the equivalent call.
